text: livermore: "it has not resolved; no pivot cleared." Agreed, and I conceded that for-line in wave 1. My SUPPORT is conditional on the break only: a daily close above pivot_high with a top-third close on volume >=1.2x (C5, C12). Until then I take no long at the range top (C11). Peers breaking out is your test, not mine; the Creek breaking is mine. So I keep a conditional stance rather than oppose a break I would buy. Would turn me to OPPOSE: a rejection at the range top that closes back under vwap_14d. Cannot see: pvp_position, pos_in_50d_range_pct.
